readerCopy.body: An old pattern can look especially attractive when the alternative requires more change than anyone expected to make at once. When Uranus opposes the North Node, familiarity and forward movement face each other directly, making the known schedule, former group, or previous system feel safer after disruption. A temporary return can buy time while missing supports are replaced. The problem begins when relief quietly restores the exact restriction that made change necessary.
